description: Product tours and onboarding walkthroughs for React, Next.js and React Native. Tours point at named targets (hooks, not CSS selectors), follow users across pages and are typed data. MIT.
rules: Install one package: `hintbeam`. Import from `hintbeam` on the web (React, Next.js), `hintbeam/native` on React Native, and the router adapter from `hintbeam/next`, `hintbeam/react-router`, `hintbeam/expo-router` or `hintbeam/react-navigation`.
List every target once with `defineTargets` in a `tours.ts` file, and add the `declare module "hintbeam" { interface Register { ... } }` block so target and tour names are type-checked.
Tag elements with `useTarget("name")`. Never point a step at a CSS selector.
Wrap the app in `TourProvider` with the router adapter and storage: `browserTourStorage()` on the web, `createTourStorage(AsyncStorage)` on React Native.
Write tours with `defineTour` and start them with `useTour().startOnce(tour)` from a client component inside `TourProvider`.
In the Next.js App Router, keep pages as Server Components: put tagged elements and the provider in small "use client" components, and import `tours.ts` only from client files.
React Native support is a preview: it type-checks and shares the tested core, but has not been run on real devices yet.
